gaps: The fixed list has no specified initial entries or authoritative source, so implementers cannot determine which banks must be selectable or prove that an unlisted bank is rejected (docs/specs/cards.md:23-24; docs/specs/cards.md:76-78).

Owner maintenance of the bank list has no defined procedure or effect on existing cards. Removing or renaming an entry could strand saved cards or change search results without a stated rule (docs/specs/cards.md:23-24; docs/specs/cards.md:52-54).

A member with a missing bank is told to use the contact address in the privacy notice, but the Accounts spec only requires showing that notice during onboarding. No route from card entry back to the address is specified (docs/specs/cards.md:28-29; docs/specs/accounts.md:57-78).

A card-listed event is linked to the member, while the accepted decision requires counts per circle. Attribution is unresolved when a member belongs to multiple circles, lists a card before joining one, or later leaves one (docs/specs/cards.md:46-48; docs/decisions/0008-first-party-usage-counters.md:16-19).

The draft requires removal to clear search results, but does not require a newly added card to become searchable or an edited card to leave old searches and enter matching new ones. That leaves the Brief’s find-a-holder flow unproved (docs/specs/cards.md:76-88; docs/product/BRIEF.md:28-30).

The invitation to add cards immediately after onboarding has no stated priority relative to returning a member to the invite link they opened. The two specs leave that handoff for implementers to guess (docs/specs/cards.md:63-67; docs/specs/accounts.md:41-45).
contradictions: The draft allows a bank or card issuer, expanding the accepted card model and Brief, which specify a fixed list of Indian banks (docs/specs/cards.md:21-24; docs/decisions/0005-card-entry-model.md:15-21; docs/product/BRIEF.md:37-39).

The draft says CVVs and OTPs are never recorded, but its stated free-text validation rejects only variants containing four or more digits. A value such as a three-digit CVV can be saved under those rules (docs/specs/cards.md:15-17; docs/specs/cards.md:33-40; docs/decisions/0002-friend-places-order.md:16-19).

The draft lets a newly onboarded member add and view their own cards before joining a circle, while Accounts says cards are returned only to members who share a circle with the holder and states no owner exception. A member with no circle cannot satisfy both rules (docs/specs/cards.md:50-51; docs/specs/cards.md:63-67; docs/specs/accounts.md:88-94).
resolutions: The spec now names the initial bank list explicitly, alphabetised, so selectability and rejection are testable.
List changes are owner releases only; banks can be added or have names corrected but are never removed, so saved cards and searches keep working.
The add-card screen shows the missing-bank hint with the owner's contact address directly.
A card-listed event carries the member and their circles at that moment (or none); later membership changes do not rewrite past events.
Added criteria requiring new cards to appear in matching searches and edited cards to move between searches.
Invite return comes first, then the add-cards invitation.
Removed 'card issuer'; the list is banks that issue cards in India, matching decision 0005 (American Express operates as a bank in India).

Why now says the app never asks for card details and blocks number-like entries; the variant rule rejects three or more consecutive digits (ignoring spaces, dashes, slashes), covering card numbers, CVVs, expiry dates and OTPs.
The card holder always sees their own cards; the Accounts enforcement rule governs what other members see.
